text:
oncall-bot: Pager: P2 regen-error-rate (eu-west) > 5% triggered at 2026-03-15T01:20:34Z. Primary: sam, Secondary: neha. Symptoms: spike in model "safe-embed-v2" regen errors and failed completions. Customer impact: intermittent 500s for chat endpoints, estimated ~2% of active requests. Auto-escalation to SRE channel if not acknowledged in 5m.

sam: acknowledged. I'm on it — joining bridge now. quick snapshot: 5m rolling error rate 6.8% on eu-west-1c, p95 lat 420ms up from 80ms.

neha: on standby, can take traffic if you need to step out.

marta: quick context — earlier we had a small KV cache eviction in eu-west around 00:55 which could correlate. I see a surge of prefetch hits dropping.

sam: checking logs, getting repeated traceback from model runner: "KVCacheReadTimeoutError" and retries causing request blowup. past hour shows frequent RPC timeouts to tokenstore.

devon: if tokenstore is flapping, can we toggle fallback routing to warm secondary region (eu-central) for non-low-latency customers? That should reduce load while we stabilize.

sam: attempting mitigation A: enable quota-based shed for regen endpoints to limit clients sending heavy batched requests. Command below to set soft-limit (will revert in 30m):

```
# set temporary quota for /v1/chat/regen
redwoodctl quotas set --route /v1/chat/regen --region eu-west --rate 30rps --duration 30m
```

sam: mitigation A applied (30rps). Observing immediate drop in new inflight regen requests. Error rate dropping to ~4.1% in 3m.

neha: I can keep an eye on customer-facing metrics and alert product if it worsens. Any ETA on tokenstore recover?

marta: tokenstore team investigating; they reported a NAT gateway noisy neighbor causing intermittent connectivity to tokenstore replicas. They're provisioning an additional path and rolling NAT tomorrow but for now will try route failover.

devon: alternative mitigation B: switch regen route to degraded model variant (safe-embed-v2-quant) which is compatible but slightly lower quality; this reduces memory pressure on runners. We can failover via routing policy:

```
# route switch (dry-run then apply)
redwoodctl routing preview --from safe-embed-v2 --to safe-embed-v2-quant --region eu-west
redwoodctl routing apply --from safe-embed-v2 --to safe-embed-v2-quant --region eu-west --force
```

sam: don't apply force yet. Let's keep quota shed and monitor while tokenstore team attempts path fix. If error rate creeps back above 6% for 10m, we will trigger the model fallback.

ops-bot: Incident note added: "regen-error-rate eu-west - quota-shed applied; awaiting tokenstore path fix; fallback model ready." Link: https://console.redwood.internal/incidents/6754321234

neha: monitoring dashboards. Current customer impact estimate updated: 1.2% of requests now seeing 500s, down from peak 2%. No major customers flagged by SRE yet, but sending heads-up to key accounts CSMs.

sam: running one-off trace to reproduce locally. Found samples where KV cache calls take >1.2s then time out. Leaving a runbook pointer here: Runbook -> Tokenstore Degraded Path (https://runbooks.redwood/internal/tokenstore-path-degrade). Follow section "temporary quota and routing fallbacks."

marta: tokenstore team confirms they routed traffic around noisy NAT for the last 4m; latency to tokenstore reduced by ~70%. They're continuing to monitor.

sam: status update: error-rate steady ~2.3% now. Keeping quota-shed for another 15m, then will ramp back unless we see regression. If anyone needs to take over, I'll pass primary to neha at 02:00Z — I'm offline after 02:10.

neha: I can take primary at 02:00Z. I'll follow escalation checklist: 1) confirm tokenstore path stable, 2) if error >5% for 10m -> initiate model fallback, 3) notify product and CSMs.

devon: prep note for fallback: have a canary route ready to route 10% traffic to safe-embed-v2-quant. test config in staging already green.

sam: last action items I left: 1) revoke quota-shed at 02:15 if stable: `redwoodctl quotas delete --route /v1/chat/regen --region eu-west` 2) monitor traces for retry storms 3) escalate to tokenstore on-call if errors spike.

neha: acknowledged. I'll post a short summary to #customer-impact if we hold at <2% by 02:10.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if secondary takes over, please update the bridge topic and add a short summary.

marta: marking incident as "mitigations applied — monitoring". I'll remain available for tokenstore follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
